title: Comparison of the road signs of the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals between the 2006 consolidated version and the 2023 revision

2006.document: Convention on Road Signs and Signals, consolidated version 2006 (Conv_road_signs_2006v_EN.pdf)
2006.numbering: Section letter + symbol number, e.g. "A, 1a", "C, 3a". For danger warning signs the model is prefixed: "Aa" (triangle) or "Ab" (square set on a diagonal).

2023.numbering: Section letter + two-digit paragraph + variant, e.g. "A-01.1", "C-03.14".

legend.legacy_id: Corresponding sign or symbol number in the 2006 consolidated version; null when the sign has no 2006 equivalent.
legend.name: Sign name as given in the 2023 revision.
legend.note: Differences of numbering, naming, models or colour between the two versions.
legend.removed: 2006 signs that have no counterpart in the 2023 revision.
legend.cancellation_band: For signs that cancel a prohibition, a restriction or an obligation: the oblique band may be drawn either as one single band ("single_band", the variant used e.g. in France) or as several parallel lines forming such a band ("parallel_lines", the variant used e.g. in Germany). "preferred" records which of the two each version of the Convention puts forward; null means the text placed them on an equal footing. The national examples are illustrative and are not part of the Convention text.
legend.prohibition_bar: For prohibitory signs: the red oblique bar that marks the prohibition itself. It slopes downwards from left to right, the opposite way to a cancellation band, and both versions of the Convention let Contracting Parties omit it on the "no entry for..." signs.
legend.band_style: On a shape entry: which of the two band variants that entry describes.
